title: Hematology Testing
definition: Hematology analyzers count blood cells and flag abnormal shapes — diagnosing anemia, leukemia, and clotting disorders. A CBC is medicine's most ordered test. Technologists review every flagged slide by eye.
patient_flow: Orders arrive electronically; phlebotomists draw blood on timed rounds while other specimens arrive by tube system. Analyzers run tests with constant quality control; technologists verify abnormal results. Critical values are phoned immediately; routine results flow to the chart. Pathologists examine tissue and sign out diagnoses that drive treatment.
code_demo:
def critical_value_alert(test, value, low, high, unit):
    """Flags lab results outside critical thresholds for immediate call."""
    if value < low: return f"CRITICAL LOW: {test} {value}{unit} - CALL PROVIDER NOW"
    if value > high: return f"CRITICAL HIGH: {test} {value}{unit} - CALL PROVIDER NOW"
    return f"{test} {value}{unit} - within critical limits"
print(critical_value_alert("Potassium", 6.4, 2.8, 6.0, " mmol/L"))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
